citation: Engeroff T, et al. Int J Environ Res Public Health 2022;19:4422
protocol: Fasted baseline then 30 min cycle ergometer at 70% VO2max (about 140 W at 70%) before 4 h sitting with one ad libitum meal (exercise-before-sitting arm), or exercise broken into 5 x 6 min, or sitting control; serial venous glucose and insulin
note: Table 2 gives baseline, max/min change and iAUC per arm rather than each minute; a meal is eaten after the bout, so the post-exercise values reflect meal plus exercise; control arm is sitting only.
